# RunningEventsNearMe

> The UK's running event directory. Find road races, trail runs, 5Ks, 10Ks, half marathons, marathons, and ultra events near you — searchable by location, distance type, and date.

## What this site does

- Lets runners search for events by postcode or "near me" (geolocation), returning results sorted by proximity in miles
- Lists running events across all UK regions: England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland
- Provides dedicated pages for each UK region, distance and terrain
- Allows race organisers to submit their events for free

## Who it is for

- Recreational and competitive runners looking for their next event in the UK
- Race organisers wanting free directory listings
- Running clubs and coaches sourcing events for members

## Data

Events sourced from England Athletics RunEvents, Welsh Athletics, Athletics NI, Scottish Athletics, and parkrun. Coverage: 2026 season, expanding continuously. Each event record includes name, date, town, county, distance type, entry fee (where known), and a link to the official event page.
